profile.headline: Backend Developer
profile.summary: My degrees in computer science and 14 years of professional experience have given me insight into not only the theoretical approaches to the design and implementation of software systems, but the practical aspects and business-side applications as well. I have been part of several teams of varying sizes during all phases of the development life cycle. I also have a strong background in mathematics, which gives me insight into engineering-related activity like capacity planning, metrics measurement, and data analysis.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
Software Engineer II (Backend) for real estate Listing Collections team.
Enhanced agent-facing features, including suggested collaborators, client invitations, and business tracking.
Contributed to Java-based microservice architecture and unit tests, utilizing Thrift, gRPC, and Go.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer II
positions.description:
Software Development Engineer 2 (L5) for Service Cost Tool team.
Designed and developed new features for an internal service that reported expenses and profitability to other Amazon cost centers.
Implemented new feature to adjust pricing models and incentivize certain cloud hosting solutions while minimizing cost.
Focused on Java-based backend API and integration with AWS systems using  internal DevOps tools.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Graphical User Interface Team - Developed new features for GT-Suite, a simulation tool designed for mechanical engineering systems

positions.title: Embedded Software Engineer
positions.description:
Embedded Software Engineer, Infrared Counter Measures.
Implemented new features on CH-53K missile defense program such as automatic system reprogramming, and simulation-based testing.
Ensured robust code by scheduling nightly build and test script execution with the automated tool Jenkins.
Tested code changes on production hardware including customer- and government-furnished equipment.
Contributed to success of company's foray into Agile development process by maintaining task status in Rally and improving sprints through bi-weekly retrospective meetings.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Software Engineer, Flight Management Systems User Interface and Performance teams. Developed and maintained software for Boeing, Embraer, Gulfstream, and Dassault aircraft. Worked closely with management and team leads to track and prioritize tasks, and acted as team liaison during new feature development and integration. Coordinated tasks between local developers and team in India to implement and troubleshoot issues around the clock. Referenced and maintained thorough software requirements regarding software appearance and behavior. Followed rigorous documentation process for code updates, which included task approval, independent code review, regression analysis, and code verification.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Software/Database Engineer for Ground Software division. Maintained and improved object-oriented LabVIEW source code to process and validate updates to a SQL database that contained satellite commanding and telemetry information. Owner of database process for the Landsat mission. Coordinated database change approvals between stakeholders and implemented changes after approval.

company.name: Orbital Sciences Corporation is now Orbital ATK!

educations.schoolName: Ira A. Fulton Schools of Engineering at Arizona State University
